The RD-1 obligation to take the shortest and most direct route is therefore not shown to be breached.

Because no off-route segment exists, the RD-2 refund formula has no extra_km input: Σ(extra_km) = 0 km, so the refundable amount is 0 × any per-km rate = $0.00 [F1][F3][RD-2]. For a RydeTAXI trip the meter charge is the fare, and the charged $21.26 is fully accounted for by base $3.90 + distance $12.42 + time $3.47 + platform $1.47, with $0.00 waiting and no discount [F5]; surge was 1.0× [F4]. No unpublished or extra item appears, so FARE-1 leaves nothing to return [F5][F4][FARE-1].

These bands are far from the band 1/2 severe-congestion threshold, so no reroute exemption under RD-4 is invoked — and equally none is needed, since no reroute occurred [F9][F10][F11][RD-4].
